features.label: Page extractor

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Give monitor checks time to settle before reading pages

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Allow Smart Window to read longer YouTube transcripts

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: clean up outcomes in PageExtractor phase telemetry

features.summary: PageExtractor now waits for page-monitor checks to settle and can read longer YouTube transcripts for Smart Window, helping it capture more complete page content. Its phase telemetry was also cleaned up so the outcomes it records are clearer.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Dão Gottwald
patches.subject: Correct the JSDoc types of getInferenceOptions, getAccuracyStats and computeRandScore.

features.summary: The documentation types for several ML actor methods were corrected so they more accurately describe their inputs and results. This helps developers understand and use inference options and accuracy statistics consistently; it does not change what users see.

features.label: ML inference engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: The ML inference engine documentation now links to other in-tree documentation using internal references instead of external Firefox-source-docs URLs. This keeps documentation links within the project and easier to maintain.

features.label: ML inference engine tests

patches.author: Neil Deakin
patches.subject: Bug 2080429, add missing splitContext function,

features.summary: The ML inference engine tests now cover splitting context into parts, addressing a missing piece in the test support for how the engine handles input. This helps make changes to that behavior easier to check.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let headless extractor tests fire the load deadline after the navigation instead of racing it

features.summary: The headless PageExtractor tests now wait until after navigation before triggering the page-load deadline. This avoids a timing race, making the tests more reliable without changing what users see.

features.label: llama.cpp (vendored)

patches.author: serge-sans-paille
patches.subject: Register SOURCE_HEADERS for third_party/

features.summary: Build configuration was updated to register source headers in the vendored llama.cpp third-party code. This is an internal housekeeping change that helps Firefox account for the bundled library’s source files.

patches.subject: Use run-if for single-condition manifest-wide scope conditions.

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Initialize ML performance utilities with context

features.summary: Work on Firefox’s machine-learning inference engine adds and exercises context splitting, model downloads using the Origin Private File System (OPFS), and inference through both llama.cpp and hardware acceleration. The expanded tests check that generation handles cancellation, process exits, and concurrent requests safely, while performance checks and telemetry help track how inference runs; test and availability checks were also updated to reduce flaky results.

patches.subject: Allow Smart Window to read longer YouTube transcripts

patches.subject: Report a headless load redirected off-site as a distinguishable block, not a generic timeout

patches.subject: Add page_extractor.phase Glean event as the twin of the PageExtractor profiler marker

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Add profiler markers to PageExtractor

features.summary: PageExtractor can now read longer YouTube transcripts, waits for page checks to settle, and distinguishes pages redirected off-site from ordinary load timeouts. Redirects within the requested site are followed, with the site matched by its registrable domain. New profiler markers and Glean phase telemetry make its progress and outcomes easier to understand and measure; telemetry also bypasses Oblivious HTTP (OHTTP) and includes automatic client metadata.

features.label: ML engine & pipelines

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Remove OPFS usage in workers;

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Re-work OPFS.sys.mjs to pass TypeScript and remove dead code;

patches.author: Greg Tatum
patches.subject: Remove incorrect isPrivateBrowsing call and test;

patches.author: Bryan Johns
patches.subject: Added /answer path for search_the_web

features.summary: The ML pipeline changes move away from using the Origin Private File System (OPFS), browser-managed storage used for model files, from workers, and clean up its supporting code. They also add an `/answer` route for web searches, allowing the feature to request answer-style results. These changes make the storage and search paths more dependable without changing the underlying ML concepts.

patches.subject: Part 3: Add HWInferenceProcess and the browser HWInference process

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 1: Manage PHWInference under PUtilityProcess

features.summary: Firefox now has a WebIDL interface for text generation, backed by inter-process communication (IPC) to an HWInference process hosted by the browser. This gives machine-learning inference a dedicated process to run in, rather than keeping that work in the page or main browser process.

features.label: ML actors

patches.author: Joe Bowser
patches.subject: Record engine_run for an abandoned runWithGenerator run

features.summary: ML inference runs now end cleanly when a consumer stops reading results from a generator, rather than continuing abandoned work. Firefox also records these abandoned runs as engine_run events, making the run’s outcome clearer in telemetry.

features.label: Native text generation

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Part 3: Add profiler markers to llama.cpp operations in HWInference

patches.subject: Implement PTextGeneration with LlamaBackend

patches.author: Valentin Pollet
patches.subject: Add PTextGeneration over the browser HWInference process

features.summary: Text generation using llama.cpp is now implemented through the browser’s HWInference process, with IPC carrying requests to the llama.cpp backend. Profiler markers were also added so developers can see how long llama.cpp operations take when investigating performance.

features.label: Page extractor tests

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Let headless extractor tests fire the load deadline after the navigation instead of racing it

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on macOS 15 AArch64 that pass there on try.

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Follow redirects within the requested site, and match it by registrable domain

features.summary: PageExtractor tests now follow redirects within the requested site, matching sites by their registrable domain, and avoid a timing race by starting the load deadline after navigation. Tests that were previously disabled on certain macOS 15 systems have also been re-enabled after passing there, broadening test coverage.

features.label: Inference library build

patches.subject: End an utterance when the decoder stops emitting tokens.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Emit one SpeechRecognition final result per utterance.

features.summary: Speech recognition now ends an utterance when the decoder stops producing tokens and emits one final result for each utterance. This makes the results users receive better match the natural boundaries in their speech.

features.label: ML inference backends

patches.subject: Part 1: Make LlamaRuntimeLinker::Init thread-safe

patches.author: Joe Bowser
patches.subject: Report when a cancelled llama.cpp generation has released the backend

features.summary: The llama.cpp runtime linker is now safe to initialize from multiple threads. Firefox also reports when a cancelled text generation has finished releasing the backend, helping ensure later work does not start before the previous run has let go.

patches.subject: Register SOURCE_HEADERS for third_party/

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Declare every about:license notice in moz.build

features.summary: The vendored llama.cpp build now registers headers from its third-party code and declares all required about:license notices. This helps Firefox build the library correctly and show its licensing information.

features.label: ML inference engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: The ML inference engine documentation now links to other in-tree documentation using internal references instead of external Firefox-source-docs URLs. This keeps documentation links within the project and easier to maintain.

features.label: ONNX inference DOM API

patches.author: Ryan VanderMeulen
patches.subject: Update onnxruntime toolchain to v1.30.0.

features.summary: Firefox’s ONNX Runtime inference library is updated to version 1.30.0, bringing the ONNX machine-learning runtime and its build toolchain up to date.

features.summary: Firefox’s browser test folders were renamed to follow the project’s ESLint test-path naming rules. This is an organizational change for development and testing, with no visible browser behavior change.

features.label: Page extractor docs

patches.author: Taimur Hasan
patches.subject: Add Page Extractor developer documentation

features.summary: New developer documentation explains how to use Firefox’s Page Extractor. It gives developers guidance for working with the feature without needing to piece together its behavior from the code.
